name: RC-Brain 3
description: RunContainer's own two-head behavioural model: structured observations in, diagnosis and action out. It can also dispatch the fixed specialist evidence agents to complete an observation it cannot act on. Trained from scratch on synthetic RunContainer scenarios; it cannot read arbitrary log text semantically, and it cannot author, configure or command an agent.

corpus.provenance: synthetic scenarios grounded in RunContainer source, tests and docs; no real user data
